gold_facts.text: A possessor in bad faith must return the thing and compensate the entitled person for all damage caused by the wrongful withholding, and for the fruits he collected or failed to collect.
A possessor in bad faith has a claim for his expenses only if the entitled person would also have had to incur them.

competing_candidates: The rules on the good-faith possessor are the counterpart and could be retrieved; the question states the possessor knew.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: letting the car out removed to avoid the rule on profits from managing another's business.

question: Someone knowingly kept my car for months after I asked for it back, and I had to hire another car meanwhile. Now he finally has to return it. What does he owe me besides the car, and can he charge me for the money he spent on it?

gold_facts.text: The members' liability and their obligation to make additional contributions in a cooperative can only be changed by amending the articles of association.

A reduction of the liability of the members or of their obligation to make additional contributions does not affect debts that arose before the amendment of the articles was published (registered, in the Italian text).

provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact 2 worded to hold in all three language versions.

question: Bei unserer Genossenschaft haften die Mitglieder bisher persönlich für die Schulden. Jetzt soll diese Haftung abgeschafft werden. Wie geht das, und müssen wir für Schulden, die schon vor der Änderung bestanden, weiterhin geradestehen?

gold_facts.text: A residential lease can be extended by at most four years in total.
Within that maximum, one or two extensions can be granted.

competing_candidates: Code of Obligations tenancy articles on when an extension can be granted at all and on the procedure for requesting it (the question asks only about duration)
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on agreed extensions removed (question asks only about a court-granted extension).

question: Il proprietario mi ha disdetto l'appartamento in cui vivo da vent'anni e per la mia famiglia è molto difficile trovare un altro alloggio in zona. Se il giudice mi permette di restare ancora un po', per quanto tempo al massimo posso rimanere in totale, e posso ottenere questo rinvio più di una volta?

gold_facts.text: A person threatened with damage from another person's building or structure can demand that the owner take the measures needed to avert the danger.

competing_candidates: Civil Code neighbour-law rules on protection against threatened damage from a landowner overstepping his property rights (weaker fit: the person threatened is a passer-by, not a neighbour)
Code of Obligations rule on the owner's liability for damage caused by a defective building (applies after damage occurs)
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on reserved police orders removed. Situation set before any damage, and the asker is not a neighbouring landowner.

question: There is an old, privately owned stone wall along the public footpath my children take to school, and parts of it are crumbling and look like they could fall onto the path. Nothing has happened yet. Can I require the owner to make it safe before someone gets hurt?

gold_facts.text: If a company controls one or more undertakings, their acquisition of its shares is subject by analogy to the conditions, limits and consequences that apply to the company acquiring its own shares.
The controlling company must create a separate statutory retained earnings reserve equal to the acquisition value of those shares.
A legal entity controls another undertaking if it directly or indirectly has the right to appoint or remove the majority of the members of its supreme management or administrative body.

competing_candidates: The article on a company acquiring its own shares (the ten percent limit and conditions) is the rule applied by analogy; it does not cover group subsidiaries.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: last clause narrowed to the balance-sheet entry, so the consolidated-accounts duty no longer answers it. B facts reduced to the control test the question states; the majority-of-votes and dominant-influence tests are ruled out or not asked.

question: Una filiale della nostra società anonima ha comprato azioni della società madre. La madre non ha la maggioranza dei voti nella filiale, ma ha il diritto di nominare e revocare la maggioranza del suo consiglio d'amministrazione. Basta questo perché valgano le regole sull'acquisto di azioni proprie, e che cosa deve iscrivere la madre nel proprio bilancio per queste azioni?

gold_facts.text: A mandate is a contract by which the agent undertakes, as agreed, to manage the business entrusted to him or to perform the promised services.
The rules on mandates apply to work not governed by the statutory provisions on other types of contract.
The agent is entitled to remuneration if this is agreed or customary.

competing_candidates: The brokerage contract rules (fee for finding a buyer) and the commission contract (selling in one's own name); the situation has her concluding the sales in the owner's name, which fits neither.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: 'finding buyers' replaced with concluding the sales in the owner's name to rule out brokerage.

question: I asked an acquaintance to sell my late mother's car and furniture for me: she was to sign the sales contracts in my name, collect the money and handle the paperwork. We never talked about money. Now that it's done she has sent me a bill. Do I have to pay her, and what kind of contract is this in the first place?

gold_facts.text: The auditor must be independent, and its independence must not be impaired either in fact or in appearance.
A direct shareholding in the company's share capital is incompatible with independence.
Employees of the auditor who are not involved in the audit may not be members of the board of directors of the audited company.

competing_candidates: The stock-company rule on the independence of the auditor in a limited audit, which states the general independence requirement but not this list of incompatibilities; the question now fixes an ordinary audit.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: ordinary audit stated.

question: Le réviseur qui contrôle les comptes de notre société anonyme possède directement une petite partie de nos actions. Notre SA est soumise au contrôle ordinaire. En plus, une employée de son bureau, qui ne travaille pas du tout sur notre dossier, siège dans notre conseil d'administration. Est-ce que cela remet en cause son impartialité aux yeux de la loi?

gold_facts.text: General meeting resolutions are void if they abolish or limit the shareholders' right to bring an action or other shareholder rights guaranteed by mandatory law.
Resolutions are void if they restrict the shareholders' control rights beyond what the law permits.

competing_candidates: The stock-company rule on challenging general meeting resolutions that breach the law or the articles, which covers voidable rather than void resolutions.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: the resolution now clearly restricts information and inspection rights below the legal level.

question: Nella nostra società anonima la maggioranza ha fatto approvare in assemblea che i piccoli azionisti non potranno più fare causa alla società né chiedere informazioni o consultare i documenti sociali, nemmeno nei casi in cui la legge lo consente. Mi hanno detto che alcune decisioni dell'assemblea sono nulle di per sé. Questa è una di quelle?

gold_facts.text: Professional marriage or partnership brokerage involving persons abroad requires authorisation and is supervised by an authority designated by cantonal law.
The Federal Council issues the implementing provisions, including the conditions and duration of the authorisation.

provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on sanctions and return-travel guarantee removed.

question: I'd like to start a business that, for a fee, introduces people in Switzerland to possible wives or husbands living abroad. Do I need some kind of official permission for this, who grants it and keeps an eye on such businesses, and where are the detailed conditions laid down?

gold_facts.text: The commercial register is a set of state-run databases.
Its purpose is in particular to record and publish legally relevant facts about legal entities, ensuring legal certainty and the protection of third parties.
Legal entities in this sense include, among others, associations, foundations and branches.

competing_candidates: The commercial-register rule on the public nature and effect of entries.
The Civil Code rule on when an association must register in the commercial register (the question asks about the register's scope and purpose, not the duty to register).
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: 'who keeps it' removed, since the rule on cantonal register offices answers that more precisely.

question: Vorrei capire che cos'è il registro di commercio e perché è utile a chi fa affari con un'azienda. E vi rientrano solo le società, o anche associazioni, fondazioni e succursali?

gold_facts.text: Where the articles grant a departing member a share of the cooperative's assets, the member's right to leave may be exercised in his bankruptcy by the bankruptcy administration.
If that share is seized, the right to leave may be exercised by the debt enforcement office.

provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: wording moved away from the article's terms (bankruptcy administration, seizure).

question: Ich bin Mitglied einer Genossenschaft, deren Statuten Mitgliedern beim Austritt einen Teil ihres Vermögens zusprechen. Gegen mich ist der Konkurs eröffnet worden. Kann jemand statt mir austreten, damit meine Gläubiger an dieses Geld kommen, und wer wäre das, wenn ein Gläubiger stattdessen auf dem Betreibungsweg darauf greift?

gold_facts.text: Rescission of the sale may be claimed even if the thing has perished as a result of its defects or by chance.
In that case the buyer only has to return what remains of the thing.

competing_candidates: The sales rule on the mutual restitution owed after rescission, which governs what is returned in general but not the case of a destroyed item.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on loss through the buyer's fault removed (the question excludes fault).

question: Ho comprato un'auto usata con un difetto ai freni che non era visibile e che ho segnalato subito al venditore. Proprio a causa di quel difetto, e non per colpa mia, l'auto è andata distrutta in un incidente. Posso ancora sciogliere l'acquisto e riavere i soldi anche se non posso restituire l'auto intera? E cosa devo restituire?

gold_facts.text: Unless otherwise agreed or customary, the agent is not entitled to reimbursement of expenses arising from the normal exercise of his activity.
The agent is entitled to reimbursement of expenses incurred on special instructions of the principal, such as transport and customs costs.
Reimbursement of expenses is owed even if the deal is not concluded.

competing_candidates: General mandate rule on reimbursement of the agent's expenses (mandatary), and commission-agent expense rules; the question fixes a permanent independent intermediary paid by commission, i.e. the agency contract.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: copied phrase on transport and customs costs replaced.

question: Lavoro in proprio come intermediario fisso per una ditta che mi paga a provvigione. Su sua richiesta esplicita ho pagato di tasca mia la spedizione della merce e i dazi per un cliente, ma poi l'affare è saltato. Ho diritto a farmi rimborsare queste spese, e posso chiedere anche i costi abituali del mio lavoro quotidiano?

gold_facts.text: If the articles contain such a provision, the board of directors must, at a shareholder's request, designate an independent proxy or a corporate proxy to whom the participation rights can be delegated.
The board must inform shareholders at least ten days before the general meeting whom they can appoint; if it fails to do so, the shareholder may be represented by any third party.
Shareholders must be able to give the proxy instructions on each proposal in the notice of meeting and general instructions on unannounced proposals and new agenda items.

competing_candidates: The general rule on proxies being bound by instructions; it does not say on which matters instructions can be given.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: last clause asks on which matters instructions can be given, so the listed-company rule applied through the reference in A is needed. Fact restating the premise (articles may limit representation to shareholders) removed. Fact from B is applied to the unlisted company through the reference in the last paragraph of A.

question: I hold shares in a company whose shares are not traded on any stock exchange. Its articles say I may only be represented at the shareholders' meeting by another shareholder, and I don't know any. What are my options for getting someone to vote for me, and on which matters can I give that person instructions, including proposals that are only raised at the meeting itself?

gold_facts.text: The non-competition clause lapses if the employer terminates the employment relationship without the employee having given him a justified reason.

competing_candidates: Neighbouring articles on the conditions, limits and judicial reduction of a non-competition clause.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on termination by the employee removed and wording changed. Fact on the employer's lost interest also removed, since the question does not raise it.

question: In meinem Arbeitsvertrag steht, dass ich nach dem Austritt eine Zeit lang nicht für die Konkurrenz arbeiten darf. Mein Chef hat mir jetzt gekündigt, obwohl ich ihm keinen Grund dafür geliefert habe. Muss ich mich trotzdem an diese Klausel halten?

gold_facts.text: Registration is based on an application, and the facts to be registered must be supported by documents.
Entries may also be made on the basis of a judgment or decision of a court or administrative authority, or ex officio.

competing_candidates: Article on the obligation of businesses to register in the commercial register.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on truthfulness of entries removed.

question: Voglio far iscrivere la mia ditta nel registro di commercio. Basta che io presenti una richiesta, o devo dimostrare con documenti ciò che dichiaro? E può succedere che qualcosa venga iscritto senza che io lo chieda?

gold_facts.text: The apprentice's legal representative must support the employer as best he can in its task and promote good relations between the employer and the apprentice.

competing_candidates: General duties of employees (care and loyalty) apply to the apprentice as well, but only A states a duty of the parent.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on the apprentice's own duty removed (the question excludes it).

question: My 16-year-old is starting a vocational training placement with a local company. Apart from what my child has to do, do I as a parent have any obligations towards the training company?

gold_facts.text: Unless the law or the articles provide otherwise, the general meeting of a cooperative takes decisions and makes elections by an absolute majority of the votes cast, including for decisions by correspondence.
Dissolving the cooperative or amending its articles requires a majority of two thirds of the votes cast.

competing_candidates: Cooperative rule requiring a stricter majority to introduce or increase personal liability or additional contributions; the question concerns an ordinary amendment to avoid it. Majority rules for the stock company and limited liability company concern other company forms.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact on stricter requirements in the articles removed (the question says the articles say nothing).

question: Dans notre coopérative, l'assemblée générale veut changer une règle des statuts sur la façon de convoquer les séances. Quelle majorité faut-il pour cela, et pour les autres décisions et élections ordinaires, si les statuts ne disent rien de particulier?

gold_facts.text: The employer may not reduce the worker's holidays because the worker took the other-parent leave, unless a standard or collective employment contract provides a different arrangement that is at least equivalent overall for the worker.
A worker who is the legal father at the child's birth, or becomes so within the following six months, is entitled to two weeks of other-parent leave.
The leave must be taken within six months after the child's birth.
The leave may be taken in weeks or in single days.

provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: fact 1 now includes the derogation by standard or collective employment contract.

question: I became a dad last month and want to take the two weeks off that fathers get. My boss says that if I do, he will cut my annual holidays accordingly. Is he allowed to do that, and by when do I have to take that time off and can I split it up?

gold_facts.text: A bondholder who did not agree to such a decision of the bondholders' community may challenge it in court if it violates the law or the contractual terms.
The challenge must be brought within one month (30 days in the German text) from the day the bondholder learned of the decision.

competing_candidates: The bond rule on challenging measures that restrict creditors' rights after their approval by the cantonal authority; the question states the decision does not affect creditors' rights.
provenance.writer_note: Revised per critic: decision narrowed to one that does not affect creditors' rights; deadline worded to hold in all three language versions.

question: Ho obbligazioni di un'impresa. L'assemblea degli obbligazionisti ha preso a maggioranza una decisione che non tocca i nostri diritti di creditori, ma che secondo me viola la legge e le condizioni del prestito; io ho votato contro. Posso contestarla davanti a un giudice ed entro quanto tempo?
